Blocked at step 1 (set-up): on production a technician's sign-in name and staff record name cannot be made different, so the set-up this test needs cannot exist there.

Tested on production, build v26.43.0-ffea43c, on 22 and 23 October 2026.

  • Set-up needed: a technician whose staff record name differs from the name on their sign-in account.
  • Tried three ways with technician Carol Neal at Truck Hill 1, reading both names after each: (1) signed in as her, Profile > Edit Profile, name changed to "David Sparks", "Change Name" pressed; (2) the same change made behind the screen; (3) her name changed back in Settings > Staff.
  • Each time both names changed together: her sign-in name and her staff record name always read the same (picture: Edit Profile just after "Change Name").
  • How it passed on staging on 21 October: staging, on an older build, already had a technician whose two names differed (sign-in "Carol Neal", staff record "David Sparks"), and every place showed the staff record name.

What needs to be done: nothing to fix in the product; the QA lead decides whether this test stays staging-only.
